newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Embraer signs $75 mln jet deal.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Embraer signs $75 mln jet deal.

text.p: Brazilian aircraft maker Embraer said it has signed a $75 million deal to sell five EMB-145 regional jetliners to British Regional Airlines.
Deliveries of the first three aircraft are scheduled for June, July and August this year, the company said in a statement.

British Regional Airlines is a British Airways Express carrier and will operate the newest jetliner from its Manchester and Southampton hubs to destinations in the U.K. and Europe, the statement said.
Embraer said it will deliver 33 EMB-145 jets in 1997 and 48 as of 1998.
Embraer is based in Sao Jose dos Campos, Sao Paulo state, and has a European branch office in Le Bourget, France, and a U.S. office in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, the statement added.
